worldcombat.skill.dualwingbeat.summary: Spread both wings and dive: one wing slams down and bats the target open, then the other catches the opening on the upswing and strikes back harder if the first landed. Dive form closes in for heavier contact at the cost of position; hover form sends wind from a distance with longer reach.
worldcombat.skill.dualwingbeat.use.0: One dive, one strike from each wing
worldcombat.skill.dualwingbeat.use.1: Bat open then upswing, landing two beats on one target
worldcombat.skill.dualwingbeat.use.2: Sweep a small forward fan of foes aside
worldcombat.skill.dualwingbeat.descripti: Each beat deals about %1$s contact damage (physical); engage range %2$s blocks, wing-fan angle %3$s degrees.

The beats are %1$s apart; the first bats each target it hits up to %3$s blocks away and the second pulls it back a little. Once the first beat lands on any target, the second gains up to +%2$s power. In dive form the first beat closes up to %4$s blocks toward the target.
In dive form the caster pulls back %1$s blocks on the second upswing; each beat reaches up to %2$s targets.
worldcombat.skill.dualwingbeat.dive.on: Dive form now: close in first; both beats are contact, heavier and quicker, but reach is shorter and you give up position.
worldcombat.skill.dualwingbeat.dive.off: Hover form now: beat wind from a distance with longer, safer reach, but each beat is lighter and the gap is longer.
worldcombat.skill.dualwingbeat.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.dualwingbeat.growth.0: From level %1$s the power per beat rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.dualwingbeat.growth.1: From level %1$s the power per beat is %2$s and the second-beat bonus rises to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.dualwingbeat.growth.2: From level %1$s the power per beat rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.dualwingbeat.preferenc: On (dive): close in first; both wing beats are contact at ×1.15 power with a shorter windup and gap, but range drops to about 3.2 blocks and you give up position. Off (hover): beat wind from a distance at about 5.6 blocks of range, safer, but each beat is ×0.9 with a longer windup and gap.
Beyond this distance it will not beat its wings and closes in first; a larger value starts the exchange sooner.
When on, low-health targets rank higher so the two beats finish them; when off, all targets rank the same.
When on, the companion may leave its post to beat its wings; when off, it only casts at what it can reach from where it stands.
world_combat.move.dualwingbeat.text.wake: Second wing drives into the opening
